units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"Have you been under a rock the whole war? I'm Captain <first> <last>!"|76|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners
units.english: "Have you been under a rock the whole war? I'm Captain <first> <last>!"
units.italian: "Sei vissuto sotto un sasso per tutta la guerra? Sono il capitano <first> <last>!"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"Never mind."|77|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners
units.english: "Never mind."
units.italian: "Lascia stare."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	"At least I don't have a disheveled hamster stuck to my upper lip."|79|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners
units.english: "At least I don't have a disheveled hamster stuck to my upper lip."
units.italian: "Almeno io non ho un criceto arruffato incollato al labbro superiore."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	Both twins look confused, and the left one responds. "We've been mining asteroids the whole war. The war was a big deal, but most of us had to keep living our lives. Do you think we have time to keep track of every warring captain?"|81|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners
units.english: Both twins look confused, and the left one responds. "We've been mining asteroids the whole war. The war was a big deal, but most of us had to keep living our lives. Do you think we have time to keep track of every warring captain?"
units.italian: Entrambi i gemelli sembrano confusi, e quello di sinistra risponde: "Abbiamo estratto minerali dagli asteroidi per tutta la guerra. La guerra è stata un evento enorme, ma quasi tutti noi dovevamo continuare a vivere. Credi che abbiamo tempo di tenere traccia di ogni capitano in guerra?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	The right one says apologetically, "Thank you for your service, Captain <last>."|82|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners
units.english: The right one says apologetically, "Thank you for your service, Captain <last>."
units.italian: Quello di destra dice, con aria di scusa: "Grazie per il tuo servizio, capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	They both give clumsy but well-intentioned salutes and return to their ships.|83|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners
units.english: They both give clumsy but well-intentioned salutes and return to their ships.
units.italian: Fanno entrambi un saluto goffo ma pieno di buone intenzioni e tornano alle loro navi.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	The left twin laughs and says, "Pardon us if we keep our eyes open and trust to our own guns." Both twins nod and depart to their ships.|86|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners
units.english: The left twin laughs and says, "Pardon us if we keep our eyes open and trust to our own guns." Both twins nod and depart to their ships.
units.italian: Il gemello di sinistra ride e dice: "Perdonaci se teniamo gli occhi aperti e ci affidiamo ai nostri cannoni." Entrambi i gemelli annuiscono e tornano alle loro navi.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	Both twins shrug and leave for their ships.|89|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners
units.english: Both twins shrug and leave for their ships.
units.italian: I gemelli alzano le spalle e tornano alle navi.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners|	Both twins' faces twist in a way that might indicate embarrassment or annoyance. It's hard to tell since their facial hair is halting any emotive power. They walk away in the direction of their ships.|92|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Asteroid Miners
units.english: Both twins' faces twist in a way that might indicate embarrassment or annoyance. It's hard to tell since their facial hair is halting any emotive power. They walk away in the direction of their ships.
units.italian: Le facce di entrambi i gemelli si torcono in un modo che potrebbe indicare imbarazzo o fastidio. È difficile dirlo, perché i loro peli del viso bloccano ogni capacità espressiva. Si allontanano verso le loro navi.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|You are relaxing in a cafe while your ship refuels, and a pair of middle-aged captains come to your table. One is Navy, the other is Free Worlds, and they bear a striking resemblance to each other.|110|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: You are relaxing in a cafe while your ship refuels, and a pair of middle-aged captains come to your table. One is Navy, the other is Free Worlds, and they bear a striking resemblance to each other.
units.italian: Ti stai rilassando in un bar mentre la tua nave fa rifornimento, e due capitani di mezza età si avvicinano al tuo tavolo. Uno è della Marina, l'altro dei Free Worlds, e si somigliano in modo impressionante.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"Captain Rain, R.N.S. Camuy," says one. "How's the <ship>, Captain <last>?"|111|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "Captain Rain, R.N.S. Camuy," says one. "How's the <ship>, Captain <last>?"
units.italian: "Capitano Rain, R.N.S. Camuy", dice uno. "Come va la <ship>, capitano <last>?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"Captain Fiona, F.S. Baobab," says the other. "We both saw you in battle against the Pug. You're the war's most accomplished captain!|112|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "Captain Fiona, F.S. Baobab," says the other. "We both saw you in battle against the Pug. You're the war's most accomplished captain!
units.italian: "Capitano Fiona, F.S. Baobab", dice l'altra. "Ti abbiamo visto entrambi in battaglia contro i Pug. Sei il capitano più valente della guerra!

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"We've been patrolling together and we saw your ship, so we've come to say hi."|113|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "We've been patrolling together and we saw your ship, so we've come to say hi."
units.italian: "Stavamo pattugliando insieme e abbiamo visto la tua nave, così siamo venuti a salutarti."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"Why are Navy and Free Worlds captains traveling together?"|118|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "Why are Navy and Free Worlds captains traveling together?"
units.italian: "Perché dei capitani della Marina e dei Free Worlds viaggiano insieme?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"Have you found any new aliens?"|122|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "Have you found any new aliens?"
units.italian: "Avete trovato nuovi alieni?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"Did you fight on the other side of the war from each other?"|127|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "Did you fight on the other side of the war from each other?"
units.italian: "Avete combattuto su fronti opposti nella guerra?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"You were on opposite sides as sisters!?"|131|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "You were on opposite sides as sisters!?"
units.italian: "Eravate su fronti opposti, pur essendo sorelle!?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"It was good meeting you both, but I must get back to my business now."|136|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "It was good meeting you both, but I must get back to my business now."
units.italian: "È stato bello conoscervi entrambi, ma ora devo tornare ai miei affari."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"Hello. Sorry, but I don't have much time to talk."|140|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "Hello. Sorry, but I don't have much time to talk."
units.italian: "Salve. Scusa, ma non ho molto tempo per parlare."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"Oh, we should've guessed you were too busy to chat," says Captain Rain.|143|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "Oh, we should've guessed you were too busy to chat," says Captain Rain.
units.italian: "Ah, avremmo dovuto capire che eri troppo impegnato per chiacchierare", dice il capitano Rain.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"The war might be over, but I'm sure there's still plenty of work for a captain such as yourself to do," says Captain Fiona. "Well it was at least nice to meet you. Stay well."|144|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "The war might be over, but I'm sure there's still plenty of work for a captain such as yourself to do," says Captain Fiona. "Well it was at least nice to meet you. Stay well."
units.italian: "La guerra sarà anche finita, ma sono sicura che ci sia ancora molto lavoro per un capitano come te", dice il capitano Fiona. "Beh, almeno è stato bello conoscerti. Stammi bene."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	"Joint police operation," says Captain Rain. "It's more common than you may think."|150|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: "Joint police operation," says Captain Rain. "It's more common than you may think."
units.italian: "Un'operazione di polizia congiunta", dice il capitano Rain. "È più comune di quanto tu possa pensare."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains|	Captain Fiona nods. "We're shutting down a galactic Spider Funk smuggling operation. It's an illegal hallucinogenic. Not addictive, but still dangerous. The organization running it is huge, well funded, and well armed."|151|0
units.context: mission:War Reactions: Navy and Free Worlds Captains
units.english: Captain Fiona nods. "We're shutting down a galactic Spider Funk smuggling operation. It's an illegal hallucinogenic. Not addictive, but still dangerous. The organization running it is huge, well funded, and well armed."
units.italian: Il capitano Fiona annuisce. "Stiamo smantellando un'operazione di contrabbando di Spider Funk su scala galattica. È un allucinogeno illegale. Non dà dipendenza, ma resta pericoloso. L'organizzazione che lo gestisce è enorme, ben finanziata e ben armata."
